entries.03775556ef56fde7: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥1,588 million. The previous consolidated fiscal year was ¥1,301 million. The figure also includes the effect of no longer recording net income attributable to non-controlling interests from the current fiscal year, following Hirayama Seisakusho Co., Ltd. becoming a wholly owned subsidiary.
entries.03c0a07b948df7b5: The company states its basic management policy as serving the local community and the nation through improving education, promoting health and welfare, and contributing to scientific and technological progress, and it states that it will pursue its own business development as a specialized coordinator centered on original products, mainly in the education sector, including elementary, junior high and senior high schools nationwide. In the private sector, it states that it will seek further expansion, including overseas markets, through providing AEDs to local governments and general companies and through the manufacture and sale of sterilizers and environmental test equipment by consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.081f3673db3c0117: Based on its founding business of educational science equipment such as microscopes and power supply units, the company states that it provides products of optimal quality to users through a broad, specialized lineup, including facility equipment such as laboratory benches and cooking counters, and health equipment such as vision testers and weight scales. It also states that its resuscitation training human body model is the only domestically produced product of its kind.
